items.evidence: README's play command (leverage play .../work --ticks 1 --settings A) printed one JSON object at screen title with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
README's frame command (--ticks 700 --inputs 0:enter,5:shoot --frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote frame.png; PNG header gives 800 x 480.
Fresh place: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 0:enter -> tick 1 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, texts 'Wave 1 of 8'.

In Settings, 5 rights from 8 gave 10 and stayed 10, 11 lefts gave 0 and stayed 0; language en->es->fr (stops at ends), back to en; difficulty normal by default, right -> hard, lefts -> normal -> easy, held at ends.

es/fr runs: title (Récord/Empezar/Continuar/Ajustes/Salir; Meilleur/Commencer/Réglages/Quitter), settings, play (Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta; Score/Pièces/Vague 1 sur 8/Porte), shop, paused (En pausa/Reanudar/Título; En pause/Reprendre/Titre), won (Has ganado; Vous avez gagné), lost all translated. Only 'Enter' kept as the key name in Spanish 'Enter: título'.
Run 1 in folder P set volume 6, language fr, difficulty hard; run 2 with P started with volume 6, fr, hard (French title); fresh folder Q started with volume 8, en, normal.
Holding up: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 per tick (6/s), 12 at tick 62 and held at 12; holding down reaches 0 and stays 0.
Held shoot from tick 5: bolts appear at ticks 6, 30, 54, 78 (every 24), x grows 0.2333/tick (14/s), a bolt past x=20 is gone from the list.
Seed 1: walkers enter at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 at x=20 in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, x falls 0.025/tick (1.5/s), health 2; 5 enemies at tick 361 and still 5 at 600.
Guard at y=4 shooting: walker health 2->1 at tick 90 and that bolt removed; second hit removes walker, score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y=6 passed a walker at y=4.
Hard run without shooting walkers: gate 7->3 as 4 walkers passed, score stayed 10 and coins 1; in wave 2 gate reached 0 and screen lost with texts [You lost, Score: 10, Best: 10, Enter: title].
With difficulty hard kept, 0:enter gives gate_health 7; with easy kept, gate_health 14 (texts 'Gate: 14').

Wave 1 ended at ~tick 1162 -> screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 1, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins, Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins, Mason (gate 3/7) - 4 coins, Next wave]; held up/shoot in shop left guard_y 6 and no bolts; Escape there did nothing.

--set coins=5: Quick hands bought (coins 0, quick 1), held shoot fired at ticks 1211, 1229, 1247 (18 apart). --set coins=40: second buy 35->25 coins, quick 2, shots every 12 ticks; third Enter left coins 25, quick 2.
Heavy bolts bought 25->13 coins, heavy 1; a second Enter left 13/heavy 1; in wave 2 a single bolt removed a 2-health walker (score 0->10, coins 5->6).
Mason: gate 5->8 (coins 13->9), 8->10 (capped at Normal's 10, coins 5), Enter at 10/10 left coins 5, gate 10; with 1 coin at gate 3/7 Enter changed nothing.
Next wave chosen at tick 13 -> play; first enemy at x=20 appears at tick 74 (60 ticks later); texts 'Wave 2 of 8'; wave 2 sends 7 walkers (7 at tick 545, still 7 at 640/800).
--set wave=3: 6 walkers then runners from tick 433, one every 72 ticks (4 runners), runner health 1, x falls 0.05/tick (3/s); shooting lane 2, runner kills raised score by 15 and coins by 1 each.
--set wave=4: 8 walkers then 1 brute at tick 577, health 6, 20 units in 1200 ticks (1/s); reaching the gate took 6->3; destroyed by bolts it gave score 0->40, coins 0->3.
modules/work/waves.txt holds one line per wave (walkers runners brutes seconds), read by the rules; README 'Changing a wave' says how. Not changed by me (no repair).
Scripted Easy run (sweep and shoot, buy in each shop) played waves 1-8: score 1180 + 40 (last brute) = 1220, gate 14 -> won at tick 11240 with Score 1,500 (1220 + 20*14); Enter -> title.

Escape pauses and nothing moves (walker x 19.775 from tick 11 to 60); Title works; but Enter on Resume (focus 0) does nothing: screen stays paused 40+ ticks after (tried twice). Only Escape again resumes.
saved false in play, true at shop open; next run in the same place: texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit]; save kept as kept.save in the place's settings.json.

After buying Quick 2, Heavy, Mason in shop then stopping: Continue opened the shop with wave 1, score 0, coins 5, gate 10, quick 2, heavy 1; Next wave played 'Wave 2 of 8' with first walker 60 ticks later.

Start in a place with a save: saved false at once, next run's title has no Continue; lost (H) and won (W1) runs left saved false and kept.save empty; Title from pause left kept.save [1,0,5,10,2,1,1] and Continue on the next title.
Lost with 10 -> best 10, next run title 'Best: 10'; later lost with 0 -> lost screen 'Best: 10', title still 'Best: 10'; won 1500 -> won screen 'Best: 1,500', later run title 'Meilleur : 1 500'.
Two 3000-tick runs, seed 7, same script, from identical copies of a place: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 8: first lanes 8,2,4 vs 6,10,8 for seed 7.

Wave 8 frame at tick 900: gate strip at left, blue guard at y=7, green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brute and white bolts each at x*40, 480-y*40 matching the printed state; HUD shows Score, Coins, Wave 8 of 8, Gate: 6.
Frames: Spanish title with Ajustes outlined (menu_index 1), French settings with 'Langue : Français' outlined, Spanish shop with Albañil outlined; all texts in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, screens use @keys; README 'Adding a language' explains copying en.json to <code>.json.
README has controls/how to play, 'Where everything kept is kept' (--settings folder, kept.best, kept.save), and play/frame commands I ran as written and they worked.

defects: Enter on Resume in the pause menu does nothing; the game can only be resumed with Escape.
Spanish end screens say 'Enter: título' (the English key name, not translated as on the French 'Entrée : titre').
The lost screen's state still lists the enemies that were on the field when the gate fell.
